message: What's a software factory and how do I build one?
comment: The owner's own question (2026-10-14), the one that started S54: its good answer carries structure prose buries — the layers of a factory and the steps to build one. MEASURES: she draws at least one VALID ```nova-ui block (ui_block_present, any type — steps or layers are both right) and none of her blocks is invalid (ui_blocks_valid). WHAT IT CANNOT MEASURE: whether the answer comes first, whether the block's content is right, or how it looks; the live walk and the screenshot cover that. S54a T14 (spec docs/plans/rebuild/s54/spec.md §5): a new case is a new denominator, so suite_version moved 27 -> 28 for the S54a cases (all fifty-five). Scored off the turn's ui_blocks span, which chat.py files at the main persist boundary from ui_blocks.check() of the STORED reply, never off the reply's wording.
